name: Don't Let It In!
author: Nathan Bourgeois (IridescentRose)
description: You're studying for your final exams one late night. Suddenly a burst of thunder claps and the rain pours down, and you can hear the sound of something scratching at the windows... Quickly now, you must close the windows, or else the beast will arrive. But you know that in this infinite hell, eventually you will fall.
